definitions.repeated_commands: Exact equality of executed command strings, beyond the first occurrence within a task. Repeating a test may be justified; this is not automatically waste.
definitions.nonzero_returns: Observed nonzero tool returns. Deliberately detecting a failing test can be useful; this does not classify an infrastructure failure.
definitions.allowed_edit: At least one allowed regular source file differs from its starting defective bytes in an observed snapshot. Deleted or symlinked paths are reported separately as invalid paths.
definitions.source_transitions: Different source-state digests between adjacent observed tool snapshots, excluding the unknown transition before the first observation.
definitions.interpretation: Observed execution behavior only; not a causal explanation of weight changes or a significance test.
